milestone: M5 standalone coordinator and private network lab
source_state: M5 implementation identified by hashes below; no unrecorded executable changes after final tests

host.contention: same shared laptop; historical Petals containers remained stopped; offline tests overlapped correctness/early smoke only; selected repeatability runs had no test container

legacy_regression.reason: new-runtime opt-in flags absent; M5 probe requires Python>=3.11

iteration_notes: Initial network-shaping preflight reported CAP_NET_ADMIN while the shaper expected NET_ADMIN; the shaper normalized the capability prefix. Containers already had the required capability.

All three attempted 100-request LAN concurrency-3 repetitions stopped at 63 completions and 137 CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED failures because the 64-record active-session-plus-tombstone bound was exhausted; the default was raised to 4,096 while retaining 30-second tombstones.
The worker supervisor and independent network-reset path were corrected; an interrupted cleanup was followed by a separately recorded and verified reset.

limitations: same-host CPU network simulation, no separate-device or GPU result
only selected configurations measured; full 48-configuration performance matrix remains uncollected
shared host and unmeasured thermal state; CPU quotas are ceilings not dedicated cores
local complete-model CPU quota is not matched to aggregate pipeline resources; no efficiency claim
network probe reports TCP exchange RTT and achieved payload goodput, not ICMP latency or physical link capacity
worker Step byte counters omit gRPC/TCP framing and control-plane bytes; partial trace samples are explicitly bounded
container memory peaks accumulate since creation; no per-case peak reset
no authentication/encryption, replay recovery, credits or pooled-memory demonstration
